MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #8
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x
   B. 6x + 2
   C. 6x
   D. 12x + 2

2. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. 1/2
   C. Cannot tell
   D. 1/4

3. What is √100? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 11
   C. 50
   D. 100

4. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 2/3
   B. 1/2
   C. 1/4
   D. 3/4

5. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 1

6. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

7. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 43

8. What is √16? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 16
   C. 5
   D. 8

9. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.6
   B. 23.7
   C. 29
   D. 23

10. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 105
   C. 44
   D. 22

11. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 75
   C. 30
   D. 20

12. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 5 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 55
   C. 32
   D. 16

13. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 25

14. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 36
   C. 18
   D. 77

15. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.6
   B. 27
   C. 27.7
   D. 33

16. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.7
   B. 15
   C. 21
   D. 15.6

17. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 1

18. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 37
   C. 31.7
   D. 31.6

19. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.7
   B. 19.6
   C. 25
   D. 19

20. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 27 cm³
   B. 9 cm³
   C. 12 cm³
   D. 18 cm³

21. Solve for x: x + 8 = 19. (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 11
   C. 12
   D. 19

22. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 4
   C. 40
   D. 10

23. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 1
   C. 13
   D. 7

24. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 169
   C. 170
   D. 26

25. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 42
   C. 36
   D. 24

26. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 21
   C. 15
   D. 3

27. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 10
   C. 40
   D. 400

28. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 1

29. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 14

   C. 49
   D. 50

30. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 81
   C. 90
   D. 36
